Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to the most common questions about how these Solo Shuffle Healer rankings are created and how to interpret the current meta.

Which Healer class is best for Solo Shuffles in WoW?

The best Solo Shuffle Healer specialization can change as the season progresses, but currently Preservation Evoker leads the rankings. These rankings are based on live data from top-rated players, ensuring they accurately reflect the current WoW Healer meta.

How are the Healer rankings determined?

Murlok gathers data from active Solo Shuffle players across US, EU, KR, and TW regions. Characters are filtered to ensure they remain active and consistently tied to a single specialization, following the same criteria as our class guides.

How often is the Healer meta updated?

Murlok Solo Shuffle Healer rankings refresh every 8 hours, keeping the page aligned with the latest trends in high-level PvP.
